assumeRoleARN.description: ARN of the IAM role to assume.

authType.description: AWS authentication method used to connect to Redshift.

clusterIdentifier.description: Identifier of the provisioned Redshift cluster to connect to.

database.description: Name of the Redshift database to query.

dbUser.description: Database user used to connect when not using a managed secret.

defaultRegion.description: Deprecated. Region used when no per-query region is supplied; use region instead.

endpoint.description: Optional custom endpoint that overrides the default Redshift Data API endpoint.

externalId.description: External ID used when assuming the IAM role.

profile.description: AWS credentials profile name (used with the Credentials file auth provider).

proxyType.description: HTTP proxy type used for outbound connections.

proxyUrl.description: URL of the HTTP proxy used for outbound connections.

region.description: AWS region used for Redshift queries.

useManagedSecret.description: Authenticate to the database using an AWS Secrets Manager managed secret.

useServerless.description: Connect to a Redshift Serverless workgroup instead of a provisioned cluster.

withEvent.description: Emit a CloudWatch event for each query run against Redshift.

workgroupName.description: Name of the Redshift Serverless workgroup to connect to.
